import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    start_hist = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    # --- order items: only purchases already made before seed_time ---
    oi_hist = db["order_items"][
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] >= start_hist) & (db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # --- orders: only fields known at seed_time ---
    orders = db["orders"]
    # delivery info is known only if delivery happened before seed_time
    delivered_mask = (
        orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    orders_known = orders.loc[
        delivered_mask,
        ["order_id", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"],
    ].copy()
    orders_known["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        orders_known["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - orders_known["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    orders_known["delivery_delay_days"] = orders_known["delivery_delay_days"].fillna(0.0)
    orders_known["is_delivered"] = 1.0

    # --- reviews: only reviews already answered (visible) before seed_time ---
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    reviews_known = reviews[reviews["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "review_score"]
    ].copy()

    # --- payments: only payments made before seed_time ---
    payments = db["payments"]
    payments_known = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    payments_agg = payments_known.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        n_payments=("payment_value", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- merge everything onto order items ---
    oi = oi_hist.merge(orders_known, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi["is_delivered"] = oi["is_delivered"].fillna(0.0)
    oi["delivery_delay_days"] = oi["delivery_delay_days"].fillna(0.0)

    oi = oi.merge(reviews_known, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi["has_review"] = oi["review_score"].notna().astype(np.float64)
    oi["review_score"] = oi["review_score"].fillna(3.0)

    oi = oi.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    oi["total_payment"] = oi["total_payment"].fillna(0.0)
    oi["avg_installments"] = oi["avg_installments"].fillna(0.0)
    oi["n_payments"] = oi["n_payments"].fillna(0.0)

    # --- time-based features ---
    oi["days_since_purchase"] = (seed_time - oi["ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    oi["recency_weight"] = np.exp(-oi["days_since_purchase"] / 90.0)

    # --- aggregate per product ---
    g = oi.groupby("product_id")

    agg = pd.DataFrame({
        "units_sold": g["order_item_id"].count(),
        "n_orders": g["order_id"].nunique(),
        "total_revenue": g["price"].sum(),
        "avg_price": g["price"].mean(),
        "std_price": g["price"].std().fillna(0.0),
        "max_price": g["price"].max(),
        "min_price": g["price"].min(),
        "total_freight": g["freight_value"].sum(),
        "avg_freight": g["freight_value"].mean(),
        "avg_delivery_delay": g["delivery_delay_days"].mean(),
        "max_delivery_delay": g["delivery_delay_days"].max(),
        "frac_delivered": g["is_delivered"].mean(),
        "avg_review_score": g["review_score"].mean(),
        "min_review_score": g["review_score"].min(),
        "frac_5star": g["review_score"].apply(lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
        "frac_1star": g["review_score"].apply(lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
        "frac_low_reviews": g["review_score"].apply(lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()),
        "has_review_frac": g["has_review"].mean(),
        "avg_order_total": g["total_payment"].mean(),
        "avg_installments": g["avg_installments"].mean(),
        "avg_days_since_purchase": g["days_since_purchase"].mean(),
        "min_days_since_purchase": g["days_since_purchase"].min(),
        "weighted_sales": g["recency_weight"].sum(),
        "weighted_revenue": g.apply(
            lambda x: (x["price"] * x["recency_weight"]).sum(), axis=0
        )["price"] if False else g.apply(
            lambda x: (x["price"] * x["recency_weight"]).sum()
        ),
    })

    # sales in last 30 / 90 days
    for days in (30, 90):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        recent = oi[oi["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()
        agg[f"units_last_{days}d"] = recent

    agg = agg.reset_index()

    # --- assemble result for all requested entities ---
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)}).merge(
        agg, on="product_id", how="left"
    )

    # fill NaN for products without history
    review_cols = ["avg_review_score", "min_review_score"]
    result[review_cols] = result[review_cols].fillna(3.0)
    frac_cols = ["frac_5star", "frac_1star", "frac_low_reviews", "has_review_frac",
                 "frac_delivered"]
    result[frac_cols] = result[frac_cols].fillna(0.0)
    result = result.fillna(0.0)

    result = result.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.astype(np.float64)

    return result
